_source: probability-cup-system-instructions-v8-final.md §10 -- lifecycle: PROVISIONAL (n=1-5) -> ACTIVE (n>=8, directionally consistent) -> CONFIRMED (n>=20 or n>=30/class) -> RETIRED. Only this lifecycle authorizes an operative rule change (D11) -- a ledger entry below ACTIVE adjusts research/inputs only, never an output floor/ceiling.

lessons.summary: Don't overrate hosts/favorites; keep win probability at the power-corrected devigged line.
Even matchups carry heavy draw mass -- don't overprice either win or star-player goals.

lessons.note: do not apply; n still ~1-2 effective; revisit at n>=5 even-matchup wins

lessons.summary: Strict 'more than' markets lose on ties -- use §5.4 exact table; crowd's tie-blind 50 is the richest well.
Player 1+ SOT >> player goal as a value market (see L7/L10 risk).
Penalty/red markets are noise; stay near base rates; absorb bad Briers without reaction.
T-floor for technical even matchups: never let fundamentals drag T >0.1 below anchor-implied; no-anchor cases get +0.2-0.3 technical-depth bump.
Striker 1+SOT: discount inside team lambda allocation (not final output) under rotation risk. Mandatory Depth Pass post-lineup.

Correlation cap: >4 markets on one latent axis -> proactive batched MC over parameter uncertainty for near-horizon matches, <=3pt logged uncertainty adjustment as fallback. Never manual output flattening.
lessons.canonical_example: QAT-SUI, 4/10 markets on Qatar attacking output axis, all underpriced 12-35, all YES, 27% of @79 total damage

lessons.summary: HT-tied ceiling 47 unless anchor-implied T < 2.2 (Bessel table §5.5).

56-70% probability band runs hot (overpriced). Corrective is input-side only: main-striker 1+SOT band lowered 60-72 -> 52-64; any modeled p in top half of 56-70 (56-70 midpoint 63+) requires an explicit written driver, else regress to lower band edge.
50-55% band runs cold (underpriced), +8.2pt (was +17.4 at n=7); 36-49 band also cold +7.2pt (n=40). Anchor/devig question, not a shading question -- do not bump outputs.

Win markets (archetype #1) run hot -- symmetric pattern (low-p underdogs over-winning AND modest favourites not winning). Corrective is input-side: hardened Dixon-Coles + overdispersion draw inflation in the 40-60 win band, marginally more fundamentals weight. NOT a floor.
Performance ranking must be RBP-first, not raw-Brier-first. Does not authorize output shading.

Goal counts mildly overdispersed vs pure Poisson (Goldman evidence, ~20k internationals). Extra clean-sheet/0-0/low-total mass in cagey games; fatter blow-out tail in mismatches. Captured as small tilts in §5.2.1, capped +/-3, merged with Dixon-Coles (do not double-count).

Favourite-longshot crowd bias is structural -- crowd over-prices salient mid-tier names/teams, under-prices the dominant favourite/boring high-prob outcome. Never a fade rule -- flag STRONG, confirm true p, submit p (D2).

prime_directives_quick_ref.D2: Calibration is the strategy -- never shade the submitted probability toward or away from a crowd estimate, audit-derived floor, or lesson below CONFIRMED.
prime_directives_quick_ref.D11: Audit-overcorrection guardrail -- any audit may propose a PROVISIONAL entry, but it may not become an operative rule (floor/ceiling/band-wide shift) until ACTIVE (n>=8 directional) then CONFIRMED (n>=20, or n>=30/class) via §9.4.
prime_directives_quick_ref.D3: Integers 1-99 only; avoid exactly 50 (breaks outcome-decode telemetry, §9.2).
